title: Independent category text colors on real gateway rows

install.basis: real candidate source checkout in its repository virtual environment

terminal.program: Talaria via POSIX PTY on macOS

actions:
Jeff authorized gemini-3.6-flash through the already-configured gemini route, selected with --session only in this isolated conversation. Gateway, credentials, profile, shared default and tester model/account were preserved.
Run a real terminal sleep/printf tool. During that owned running session, queue an invalid model/provider choice using config.set with --session. The next turn emits actual gateway error at source sequence93: Could not switch model: Unknown provider acceptance-unavailable. The rejected choice is not applied and the turn completes on gemini-3.6-flash. No synthetic inbound event is used.
Actual gateway rows cover user, assistant, reasoning, tool/activity, session and fault. Reviewed text colors before and after theme reload were [{"operator": "00ff66", "assistant": "00e5ff", "reasoning": "e040fb", "activity": "ffea00", "session": "ff9100", "fault": "ff6e6e"}, {"operator": "69f0ae", "assistant": "80d8ff", "reasoning": "ea80fc", "activity": "ffff8d", "session": "ffd180", "fault": "ff8a80"}]. Cell foregrounds reconstructed at the bound ANSI offsets match all twelve requested colors. Inline-code syntax styling is distinct from plain category text.
The complete application and control wire logs retain every frame without event filters: [{"frames": 116, "requests": 36, "methods": {"agents.list": 1, "approval.pending": 8, "commands.catalog": 2, "delegation.status": 1, "prompt.submit": 2, "session.active_list": 9, "session.create": 1, "session.list": 9, "session.most_recent": 1, "slash.exec": 1, "spawn_tree.list": 1}}, {"frames": 5, "requests": 2, "methods": {"config.set": 1, "session.active_list": 1}}]
The gateway also produced the visible session notice stream began without a message.start event after the error. The frame preserves it.

expected.text: Render all six real category rows, change their distinct foregrounds and reload; each supported category uses its intended color.

actual:
Both frames were visually reviewed, with exact cell-color checks. The selected palette clears the existing contrast floor. The earlier too-dark red attempt remains private and is not used to claim an intended color.
